title: Love, family and loss
theme: relationships, family life, mourning and faith
goal: Recognise and use 23 words for couples, family, mourning and religious life.

example.fr: Les époux doivent signer le contrat de mariage.
example.en: The spouses must sign the marriage contract.

example.fr: Ils ont fêté leurs fiançailles au restaurant.
example.en: They celebrated their engagement at a restaurant.

example.fr: Sofia sera ma demoiselle d'honneur.
example.en: Sofia will be my bridesmaid.

example.fr: Après la rupture, il a déménagé à Toronto.
example.en: After the break-up, he moved to Toronto.

example.fr: Mes parents ont divorcé quand j'avais dix ans.
example.en: My parents got divorced when I was ten.

example.fr: Viens, je te fais un câlin.
example.en: Come here, I'll give you a hug.

items.note: Faire un câlin à quelqu’un = to hug someone.

example.fr: Il faut respecter l'intimité de vos enfants.
example.en: You need to respect your children's privacy.

example.fr: Mon surnom à l'école, c'était « Coco ».
example.en: My nickname at school was “Coco”.

example.fr: Mon petit-fils a commencé l'école cette année.
example.en: My grandson started school this year.

example.fr: Une fillette jouait seule dans le parc.
example.en: A little girl was playing alone in the park.

example.fr: Mes ancêtres sont venus de Bretagne au 17e siècle.
example.en: My ancestors came from Brittany in the 17th century.

example.fr: Noël réunit toute la famille.
example.en: Christmas brings the whole family together.

example.fr: Depuis la mort de son mari, elle est veuve.
example.en: Since her husband died, she has been a widow.

example.fr: Il est allé voir son père mourant à l'hôpital.
example.en: He went to see his dying father in hospital.

example.fr: Elle est en deuil depuis la mort de sa mère.
example.en: She has been in mourning since her mother died.

example.fr: Les funérailles auront lieu samedi.
example.en: The funeral will take place on Saturday.

example.fr: Toutes mes condoléances pour ta grand-mère.
example.en: My condolences about your grandmother.

example.fr: Le cercueil était couvert de fleurs.
example.en: The coffin was covered with flowers.

example.fr: Chaque année, il met des fleurs sur la tombe de sa mère.
example.en: Every year, he puts flowers on his mother's grave.

example.fr: Mon grand-père a laissé un testament chez le notaire.
example.en: My grandfather left a will with the notary.

example.fr: Elle dit une prière avant de dormir.
example.en: She says a prayer before going to sleep.

example.fr: Au Québec, beaucoup d'églises catholiques deviennent des centres communautaires.
example.en: In Québec, many Catholic churches are becoming community centres.

example.fr: Le prêtre a béni les nouveaux mariés.
example.en: The priest blessed the newlyweds.

blocks.title: Usage tips
blocks.body:
- [[Les fiançailles]], [[les funérailles]] and [[les condoléances]] are always plural.
- [[Les funérailles]] is common in Québec; in France people usually say [[l'enterrement]] or, formally, [[les obsèques]].
- [[Le testament]] is a legal will, not a religious text.
- Québec: say [[Mes sympathies]] as well as [[Mes condoléances]].

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: Repeat each sentence out loud, then record yourself and compare.

steps.intro: Answer without scrolling back. Getting something wrong now helps you remember it later.

blocks.prompt: A colleague's father has died. What do you say?
blocks.explain: [[Toutes mes condoléances]] is the standard way to express sympathy.

blocks.prompt: Which word fits? « Après la ___, Lucie a pleuré pendant des semaines. »
blocks.explain: [[La rupture]] is the end of a relationship.
[[Divorcer]] takes avoir in the passé composé: [[ils ont divorcé]].

blocks.prompt: My granddaughter is five years old.

blocks.en: Come here, I'll give you a hug!
blocks.explain: [[Faire un câlin]] = to give a hug.

blocks.en: Christmas brings the whole family together.

blocks.fr: Ils ont fêté leurs fiançailles au restaurant.
blocks.explain: [[Fiançailles]] has a ç and is plural.

blocks.fr: Elle est en deuil depuis la mort de sa mère.
blocks.en: She has been in mourning since her mother died.
blocks.explain: [[Être en deuil]] = to be in mourning.

summary:
- Talk about couples and family: [[époux, fiançailles, rupture, divorcer, petit-fils]]
- Speak about death politely: [[Toutes mes condoléances]], [[être en deuil]], [[les funérailles]]
- Recognise words of faith: [[prière, bénir, catholique]]
